component: Account Hub sync keyboard test boundary

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted sync test selects one calendar and address book, arms backend observers, focuses the calendar checkbox and asserts the Account Hub container shadowRoot.activeElement is that checkbox before pressing Enter. A separate skip case presses Enter from configuration and password controls before activating Skip. For this native form flow, recommend checking the actual focused control before synthesizing a key; invoking a controller method alone would not test submission routing. These are written source assertions, not a passed keyboard or accessibility run. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Current sync submission tests verify focus before pressing Enter
